title: Next Greater Element
summary: For every number, find the first strictly larger number to its right, or -1 if there is none.

tests.explain: 1 and 2 both see 3 first. 3 sees 5. Nothing to the right of 5 or 4 is bigger, so both get -1.
Every value is smaller than everything before it, so no element ever finds a bigger one to its right.
Equal is not greater: none of the 3s has a strictly larger value after it.

hints: The brute force scans right from every index: O(n²). Can one left-to-right pass settle each element as soon as its answer appears?
Keep a stack of indices that are still waiting for a bigger number. Their values decrease from bottom to top.
For each new value, pop every waiting index whose value is smaller: the new value is its answer. Then push the new index. Whatever is left on the stack at the end gets -1.

complexity.time: O(n): every index is pushed once and popped at most once
complexity.space: O(n): the stack and the result array
